golden_baseline_location: procs/transcripts/rating/RATING-001..008.json (8 recorded legacy transcripts, pinned by SOURCE_SHA/FIXTURE_SHA), plus federated LIVE comparison of rating_results. Pilot unit: its recon is the evidence the dictionary survives contact with real data.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (T1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.

loaded_rows + quarantined_rows == source_rows for every table in the unit, and the quarantine count is reported next to every money figure (T2/T3, §Quarantine). Quarantine above 5% of source rows halts the unit and escalates (STOPA-QUARANTINE).
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.
All 8 rating transcripts reproduce exactly on billable_units, used_units and rollover_units.

sp_finalize_rating persists rollover_units as GREATEST(quota_units - used_units, 0), which is NOT the g_rollover_units it just computed (D-09). Persist the source formula verbatim; a converter that 'fixes' the inconsistency breaks parity on every row.
Oracle LEAST/GREATEST propagate NULL, Spark's do not (D-01). Every LEAST/GREATEST is wrapped so a NULL argument yields NULL.

Tier break at 101 units, the double cap, the three-month rollover accumulation, and suspension proration are applied in the source's order (D-13); reordering them changes money even when each step is individually correct.
Usage is summed over the source's string-date comparison semantics (D-07), which truncate; converting to timestamp comparison changes which usage events fall in the period.
f_md5_uuid is reused verbatim as the deterministic MERGE key (D-14) so a rerun updates rather than duplicates; the key derivation is asserted against the source's for a sample of rows.

Pilot exit obligation: every dictionary correction discovered here is written back into .migration/09_semantic_dictionary.md before any wave-3 child starts, and the recon report states the true quarantine rate observed on real data.

planted_anomalies.description: Persisted rollover_units differs from the computed value.
Rating carries results in package globals across calls, so a second call in the same session can see the first's state.
Usage windowing by comparing formatted date strings.
ROWNUM <= 1 without ORDER BY inside the rating lookup.
WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL paths that hide a failure and return a partial result.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: A period with no usage events produces a zero-usage rating row exactly where the source produces one, and no row where the source produces none. The transcripts pin which of the two it is.
